description: One plan with its state, what it has spent, and the posts it generated. This is what you poll after create_ai_plan: while the state is pending or generating nothing exists yet, and generation can take minutes. Once it is generated, the posts are ORDINARY publications in draft state — read them with get_publication and edit or schedule them with update_publication, not with anything here. A failed plan carries the reason in error, and a generated one may still carry warnings worth reading out.

id_ai_plan.description: The plan id, from list_ai_plans or create_ai_plan.
